# Tril$oft VST Division

> Weird VSTs no one asked for. Tril$oft is an independent developer selling audio plug-ins.

## Plug-ins

- [Wild Card](https://vst.trilsoft.com/wildcard): DJ scratch VST for MIDI DJ controllers, tested with the Hercules DJControl Starlight. $13.
- [Conceal-N-Strike](https://vst.trilsoft.com/conceal-n-strike): 64-step turntablism sequencer where each step has a platter CONCEAL move and a fader STRIKE cut. $15 launch price, $19 after launch.
- [MIDI Fart Sniffer](https://vst.trilsoft.com/midi-fart-sniffer): MIDI groove browser. Point it at a folder of drum MIDI and it plays the groove into your drums, locked to the host tempo and bar. VST3, CLAP, Audio Unit, Max for Live, and a standalone macOS app.

## Support

- [Help](https://vst.trilsoft.com/privacy): Questions go to help@trilsoft.com.
- [Wild Card mapping](https://vst.trilsoft.com/wildcard): Controller mapping requests use the subject "Wild Card Mapper Request" to help@trilsoft.com.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://vst.trilsoft.com/privacy): Tril$oft sets no cookies of its own and does not collect visitor data.
- [Refunds](https://vst.trilsoft.com/refunds): Digital sales are final, with no automatic refunds. If a plug-in won't install, activate, or work as the page says, email help@trilsoft.com.

## How it works

- [Wild Card](https://vst.trilsoft.com/wildcard): Run the installer, put it on a MIDI track, activate with the code from your purchase email, load a sample, then scratch on a Hercules DJControl Starlight or by scrolling the record.
- [Conceal-N-Strike](https://vst.trilsoft.com/conceal-n-strike): Run the installer, drop it on an instrument track, activate with the code from your purchase email, then program each of 64 steps with a platter CONCEAL move and a fader STRIKE cut.
- [MIDI Fart Sniffer](https://vst.trilsoft.com/midi-fart-sniffer): Run the installer, activate with the code from your purchase email, open a folder of drum MIDI, click a groove, and route the MIDI into a drum instrument. In Live use the Max for Live device or a second track's MIDI From. In Logic use the MIDI FX slot.
